import html # The base HTML structure with a placeholder for user content. html_template = """ Visitor Message

Visitor Message

{user_content}
""" def render_html_page(visitor_message: str) -> str: """ Safely embed a visitor's message into the HTML template. Args: visitor_message: The raw text provided by a user. Returns: A string containing the complete HTML page with the message inserted. """ # Escape any HTML special characters to prevent injection attacks. safe_content = html.escape(visitor_message) # Insert the escaped content into the template. return html_template.format(user_content=safe_content)
